span.p:
SC-005 happy path, should
Given The PRD set has its functional requirements and scenarios written. The developer starts work on the export feature.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: When The developer needs the requirements and scenarios about export.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The developer enters the search term "export" and selects the category "functional requirements".

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The developer sees the matching requirements, best match first, each with its id and section.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The developer changes the category to "all" and sees the matching scenarios as well.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The developer exports the user journeys and functional requirements sections as one editable document and sends it to the team.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: Then The developer sees only the items that contain "export", best match first, each with its id and section. The team receives one file with only the two selected sections.
